scope: Current workdir-fixed v2-0930 conversion of82; original four-model328 trial outputs; current workspace v1 runner as a comparison, not a certified upstream v2 reference implementation.

findings.title: test_patch is not delivered or validated
findings.evidence: Source test_patch is nonempty for82.72 scripts require /tmp/test.patch;69 cached images contain exact source bytes;3 lack it. Converter never emits the field.
findings.attribution: Image packaging lacks the file; converter passes the missing dependency through. The local v1 evaluator also relies on image/embedded patches, so Harbor did not delete an existing file.
findings.action: Deliver exact source patch to verifier-private assets and validate before executing tests; do not expose it to the solving agent. Preserve Go embedded-script handling.

findings.title: Shared verifier workspace instead of fresh-container patch replay
findings.evidence: 328/328 original audited results report shared. Local v1 test_run.py:202 creates fresh evaluation container and reapplies exported model_patch; original solver captures initial baseline tree and binary diff. Current conversion config provides neither separate verifier nor baseline-relative patch export.
findings.attribution: Our adapter selected Harbor defaults; this is not a lost source JSON field.
findings.action: Capture final source patch against pre-agent baseline before verifier; replay it into a fresh copy of the cached image and check application. Preserve preexisting image setup changes.
findings.uncertainty: This exposes evaluation to agent-modified dependencies, caches and temporary files. No controlled replay was performed to count changed rewards. It does not by itself explain every reverse patch.

findings.title: Reported success can override shell failure; explicit patch-failure marker ignored
findings.evidence: Controlled examples: OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=0 with raw exit7 => converted reward1 vs v1 false; OMNIGRIL_TEST_PATCH_APPLY_FAILED=1 with exit0 => converted reward1 vs v1 false.
findings.action: Require successful raw exit and successful reported status; reject explicit patch-install failure, record setup/evaluation status separately.

findings.title: Original runner execution requirements are absent from instruction wrapper
findings.evidence: Local v1 prompt_for lines97-109 instructs implementation, no reference-patch network access, no commits, and removal of non-solution artifacts. Converter emits raw problem_statement only for82/82.
findings.attribution: The task statement is intact; supplemental harness instructions were not migrated.
findings.action: Restore a versioned execution prompt and preserve the original task statement verbatim. Prompt text alone is not an enforcement mechanism.
findings.uncertainty: Planning-only traces existed previously, but omitted prompt text alone is not proof of causation.

other_boundaries.source_verifier_defects: 72/82 raw eval scripts already contain unsafe patch --batch --fuzz=5 fallback; conversion copied it verbatim. Failure to stop on setup/build errors and patches containing production code are upstream issues.
other_boundaries.base_image_dirty_explanation: Kafka switches Gradle distribution URL to a mirror; Aimee adds go.sum entries. They preexist agent startup; blindly resetting to base would erase them.
other_boundaries.network_and_resources: v1 solver uses host network; v1 evaluator defaults to offline/no network; current Harbor uses bridge/public network and clears proxy vars. Current4CPU/32GiB/7200agent/3600verifier are experiment settings, not copied dataset fields. v1 evaluator default2400s. These prevent treating protocols as identical.
other_boundaries.old_score_postprocessing: v1 _process_one_instance can mark both failed model/gold outputs as pass when their outputs/reason match (lines338-345). Harbor does not copy that heuristic. This is a protocol difference, not a recommended behavior to restore.
other_boundaries.oracle_apply_difference: Oracle solve.sh uses strict git apply; v1 evaluator tries GNU patch on failure. Payload is preserved exactly; gold replay equivalence for82 was not executed in this audit.
other_boundaries.embedded_patches: 8/10 byte-match normalized source. Remaining2 (flowcraft,lerd) put deleted-file removals in explicit shell loops; all retained diff bytes and deleted-file lists match source, so no test-loss evidence from those2.
other_boundaries.runtime_user: 82 cached images default to root (78 unspecified,4 root). v1 Claude solver explicitly uses1000:1000 after chown; current Harbor follows image default. Permission/HOME behavior differs, though no new root-cause claim was made.
other_boundaries.image_entrypoints: 27 cached images declare Maven/Node entrypoints. Probe overrides entrypoint for read-only inspection; actual Harbor preserves it. v1 solver disabled entrypoint, while v1 evaluator retained it. No startup-failure attribution made.

not_performed: No benchmark test suite, oracle/no-op or paired original-vs-Harbor replay
No package installation, image pull/build, production configuration or running-trial modifications
